obs: "It is also a material circumstance in the construction of the act, that ample provision is made for the very case. A new capias may be awarded, to take the person of the debtor. This remedy is not allowed in the case of an escape ; and it is strong evidence that the legislature did not contemplate a departure from the rules, under a certificate issued by proper authority, as an escape..."
